verdict.rationale: Persona's Workflows feature explicitly lets users define trigger-based automation rules — 'All workflows begin with a trigger' and can 'automatically tag high-risk inquiries, run additional reports when specific conditions are met, or ingest non-Persona, 3rd party data,' directly matching the story of automatic event-triggered actions. This is reinforced by webhook event support for reacting to state changes. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the workflow builder in practice and deeper documentation of conditional logic/rule complexity.
